# libghostty-vt (vendored)

Adapted from [pingdotgg/t3code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code)
`apps/web/src/terminal/ghostty/vendor/` (same bytes as upstream `main`).

- `ghostty-vt.wasm` — 630932 bytes, official libghostty-vt C ABI
- `ghostty-write-pty.wasm` — 112 bytes, PTY callback trampoline
- `LICENSE` — Ghostty MIT, from t3code `native/libghostty-vt/LICENSE`

tahcode does not rebuild the WASM.
